fields.label: Instructions

fields.description: What to do each run. The co-worker can ask for clarification in Chat.

fields.label: Saved instructions
fields.description: Manage explicit preferences and working rules in Chat > Memory. Applies to future runs.

starter_questions: What do you need from me to create a useful summary?
How can I try the bundled sample files?
What did you deliver, and which checks remain?

setup_guide.introduction: I'll turn your chosen files into a summary or another deliverable you describe. Try the synthetic sample, or choose your own files and instructions; I'll read the input and save new work in a separate output folder. Review the selected folders before starting.

sample.title: File summary sample
sample.description: Summarize synthetic Java and Markdown files without supplying your own documents. Normal model preparation still applies.
sample.expected_output: With the default instructions, expect summary.md and a saved explanation of checks and unfinished work after the sample run completes.

real.introduction: Choose the read-only input folder, a separate output folder and instructions describing the result you want. I’ll deliver new work in output and explain the checks and anything unfinished.

fields.label: Input folder
fields.description: Read-only task material, including Markdown files and source code. Generated work belongs only in the output folder.
